newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 96 MOBILE PHONE WHOLESALES VALUE UP 20 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 96 MOBILE PHONE WHOLESALES VALUE UP 20 PCT.

text.p: The value at wholesale prices of 1996 sales in Finland of new mobile phones to retailers rose 20 percent year-on-year to 850 million markka, the Association of Electronics Wholesalers said in a statement on Friday.
Earlier in January, the association said wholesalers and importers delivered 500,000 new mobile phones to retailers last year, up 30 percent from 384,000 units in 1995.
Total consumer and entertainment electronics sales in Finland at retail prices rose 10 percent last year to about seven billion markka, it said, forecasting 15 percent growth in this segment in 1997.
"Improved consumer demand ... and strong demand for mobile phones contribute to the favourable expectations," the association said.
Earlier in January, it forecast that sales of new mobile phones in Finland would rise to 600,000 units in 1997.
